purpose: Exact user-selected reducer palette for GL40/GL30 fixed-hardware 07/08/09 study. Active study files are owned by the study importer.

reducers.name: SITO HD-14 50:1 (fixed GL study; exact drawing retained)
reducers.inertia_reference: Published table does not establish the shaft side. Do not reflect through ratio or assign this as rotating input inertia.
reducers.geometry_envelope_status: Model-specific drawing: nominal round 70 mm OD and 17.50 mm overall axial stack; custom input adapter not included.
interface_notes: Motor adapter/coupler is additional; an 8 mm bore motor does not directly establish the reducer input interface.
Flange drawings do not establish allowable output-bearing moments or axial/radial loads.

reducers.name: SITO CD-17 50:1 (fixed GL study; exact drawing retained)
reducers.inertia_reference: Published table does not establish the shaft side. Do not reflect through ratio or assign this as rotating input inertia.
reducers.geometry_envelope_status: Model-specific drawing: nominal round 62 mm OD and 26.50 mm overall axial stack; main body 24 mm; custom input adapter not included.
interface_notes: No 30:1 CD-17 rating or selectable product variant is published in the inspected official sources. Do not invent a CD-17 30:1 variant.
Drawing calls out ten 3.4 mm through holes on 56 mm bolt circle, eight M5 depth 10 output holes, and input-side M3 holes.
The motor adapter/coupler is additional to the nominal reducer envelope.

reducers.name: SITO CS-11-1U-E 30:1 (fixed GL study; exact drawing retained)
reducers.inertia_reference: Published table does not establish the shaft side. Do not reflect through ratio or assign this as rotating input inertia.
reducers.cross_section: 39 mm round body with chamfered 40 mm square mounting flange
reducers.geometry_envelope_status: Exact variant drawing supersedes generic family page dimensions. radius_mm=20*sqrt(2) conservatively encloses a 40 mm square flange including its undimensioned chamfered corners. It is not an actual round-body radius. length_mm=56.5 includes the 20 mm input-shaft projection and 0.5 mm output lip.
reducers.square_flange_bounding_circle_note: Conservative envelope of an unchamfered 40 mm square; the drawing has undimensioned corner chamfers. This is not an actual round part diameter.

published_family_envelope.note: Product-page prose is a generic family envelope; exact drawing defines selected variant geometry. Mass remains the published family upper bound because a tighter selected-variant mass was not established.

interface_notes: Four M4 mounting holes depth 8; six M3 output holes depth 5 on a 20.5 mm bolt circle.
Drawing identifies a 6 mm input shaft with a 14 mm flat portion. Adapter/coupler to GL30 is additional.
The user-specified 40 x 56.5 mm matches flange across-flats width and total axial length, not a cylindrical diameter.
A simple radius-20 cylinder does not enclose square flange corners. Detailed geometry/collision clearance must use the square flange dimensions or a conservative radial bound.

assumptions: Rated torque is the published 2000 rpm input-speed reference. No lower-speed torque uprating is assumed.
Repeated peak torque is used for normal acceleration/deceleration; momentary emergency torque is retained only as source data.
Average torque, average input speed, bearing load capacity, efficiency, adapter mass and rated life need separate checks; unknowns remain null.
CS-11-1U-E body width and shaft projection are taken from its exact drawing, not the generic family envelope.
